entries.zh: 委员会承诺让选拔过程更加公开透明。

entries.en: The charismatic director persuaded volunteers to attempt a much larger production.
entries.zh: 那位富有魅力的导演说服志愿者尝试规模大得多的演出。

entries.en: His sudden outburst of anger silenced the cheerful conversation.
entries.zh: 他突然大发雷霆，使欢快的谈话停了下来。

entries.en: The history chapter examines the causes of a rural insurgency.
entries.zh: 历史书的这一章考察了一场乡村叛乱的起因。

entries.en: The puppet's unnatural movements made the scene strangely unsettling.
entries.zh: 木偶不自然的动作让这个场景显得莫名令人不安。

entries.en: The forgotten compost bucket began to stink in the heat.
entries.zh: 被遗忘的堆肥桶在高温中开始发臭。

entries.en: Her rural upbringing gave her a lasting love of open spaces.
entries.zh: 她在乡村长大的经历让她一直热爱开阔的空间。

entries.en: Two bright umbrellas dominate the foreground of the painting.
entries.zh: 两把鲜艳的伞占据着画面的前景。

entries.en: She wrapped a blueberry muffin in a paper napkin.
entries.zh: 她用纸巾包起了一个蓝莓马芬蛋糕。

entries.en: The evening ended with a lively lesson in salsa.
entries.zh: 这个夜晚以一堂活泼的萨尔萨舞课结束。

entries.en: The map marks the tidal channels around the island.
entries.zh: 地图标出了环绕岛屿的潮汐水道。

entries.en: A tiny garden flourished on the library's rooftop.
entries.zh: 一个小花园在图书馆屋顶上长得欣欣向荣。

entries.en: The little rogue had hidden every spoon in the house.
entries.zh: 那个小淘气把家里每把勺子都藏起来了。

entries.en: Her entrepreneurial approach turned a spare room into a busy studio.
entries.zh: 她以创业者的思路把闲置房间变成了忙碌的工作室。

entries.en: The visiting cleric examined the ancient manuscript with great interest.
entries.zh: 来访的教士饶有兴趣地察看那份古老手稿。

entries.en: The seminar distinguished normative claims from descriptions of actual behavior.
entries.zh: 研讨课区分了规范性主张与对实际行为的描述。

entries.en: The testimony exposed the brutality concealed behind the official reports.
entries.zh: 证言揭露了官方报告背后掩藏的残暴行为。

entries.en: The leaking roof was an unwelcome discovery during rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时发现屋顶漏水，实在令人不快。

entries.en: He stomped upstairs after losing another argument.
entries.zh: 又一次争论输了后，他跺着脚上了楼。

entries.en: The horse widened its nostrils at the unfamiliar smell.
entries.zh: 闻到陌生气味时，那匹马张大了鼻孔。

entries.en: The wig covered the actor's scalp throughout the performance.
entries.zh: 整场演出中，假发都盖着演员的头皮。

entries.en: The vegetable curry arrived in a deep ceramic bowl.
entries.zh: 蔬菜咖喱盛在一只深陶碗里端了上来。

entries.en: The oppressive heat emptied the normally busy market.
entries.zh: 闷热难耐的天气使平时繁忙的集市空了下来。

entries.en: A regular tea drinker, he always carried his own mug.
entries.zh: 他经常喝茶，总是随身带着自己的杯子。

entries.en: The artist added a fine line beneath each eyelid.
entries.zh: 画家在每只眼睑下添了一条细线。

entries.en: They renamed the hall after its longtime caretaker.
entries.zh: 他们用老管理员的名字重新命名了礼堂。

entries.en: The caretaker unlocked the gate before the volunteers arrived.
entries.zh: 志愿者到来前，管理员打开了大门。

entries.en: The old railway passes through farmland dotted with small ponds.
entries.zh: 旧铁路穿过点缀着小池塘的农田。

entries.en: The downside of the beautiful attic was its low ceiling.
entries.zh: 那间漂亮阁楼的缺点是天花板低。

entries.en: Distant gunfire was heard in the film's opening scene.
entries.zh: 电影开场一幕中传来了远处的枪声。

entries.en: The novel condemns men who dismiss the heroine as a whore.
entries.zh: 小说谴责了那些把女主人公侮称为娼妓的男人。

entries.en: The anniversary concert reunited musicians who had not played together for years.
entries.zh: 周年音乐会让多年未合作演奏的乐手重聚。

entries.en: The fugitive in the novel finds shelter inside an abandoned mill.
entries.zh: 小说中的逃亡者在一座废弃磨坊里找到了藏身处。

entries.en: The photograph reveals a coastline shaped by countless small inlets.
entries.zh: 照片展现了一条由无数小海湾构成的海岸线。

entries.en: The youngest contestant built a remarkably steady model tower.
entries.zh: 最年轻的参赛者搭建了一座格外稳固的模型塔。

entries.en: The former brokerage occupied two floors of the building.
entries.zh: 那家昔日的经纪公司曾占据这栋楼的两层。

entries.en: The shelf began to sag under the heavy art books.
entries.zh: 书架隔板在沉重的艺术书籍下开始弯垂。

entries.en: Only two organizers were privy to the surprise plan.
entries.zh: 只有两名组织者知道这个惊喜计划。

entries.en: The audit found no evidence of wrongdoing by the staff.
entries.zh: 审计没有发现员工存在不当行为的证据。
